text: Does the cloud appear thin, translucent, or opaque?
description: Thin: the disc of the Sun or Moon can be seen through the cloud. Translucent: you can tell where the Sun or Moon is, but no clear disc is visible. Opaque: you can't tell where the Sun or Moon is at all.

answers.label: Thin
answers.description: The disc of the Sun or Moon can be seen through the cloud.

answers.label: Translucent
answers.description: The position of the Sun or Moon can be determined, but no clear disc is visible.
